label: Best time
value: End of September is the advised trekking time; the Kalam and Swat trekking guide adds the lakes are best in summer
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: The best time to go trekking in Kalam and Swat Valley is the end of September.

label: Jeep to the top
value: About PKR 6,000 to 7,000 for a jeep; the driver waits until you return (2021 fare, check locally)
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: Jeeps to the top are about 6,000 to 7,000 Rs, and they'll wait for you until you return.

label: Access
value: Two tracks reach the lake, one from Kundal and one from Ladu Valley
source: GuestKor Tourism, Spin Khwar Lake guide (undated)
quote: The lake is accessible through two tracks, one from Kundal and the other from Ladu valley.

label: Hike from Ladu Valley
value: About 3 hours of steep climb after the wooden bridge, on whatever tracks are found
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: follow whatever tracks you can find straight uphill

label: Time for the day
value: 4 to 5 hours for one lake from Ladu Valley
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: Time: 4-5 hours for one lake if starting from Ladu Valley.

label: Where to stay
value: Kalam town hotels; PTDC Motel rooms about PKR 4,000 a night (2021 price)
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: Rooms are around 4,000 Rs, while cottages run around 6,000 Rs per night.

label: Phone signal
value: 4G coverage across Kalam; Zong is the best network for the valley
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
quote: You should have 4G coverage throughout Kalam.

label: Altitude
value: About 3,180 m at the place point (Copernicus DEM); the mapped path ends about 140 m lower
source: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM, sampled by the TinyAtlas build
quote: DEM value sampled at 35.43375, 72.45202 (3180.7 m) and at the path end 35.42289, 72.43378 (3042.1 m)
